## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix starts with a test that fails before the fix)
- [ ] The docs page is added or updated
- [ ] A changeset is added for every published package that changed (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` (or the package's `AGENTS.md`) is updated if a convention changed
